iris.$description: Iris — Primary brand color — gradient headline text, icon strokes, accent borders, focal links. The only chromatic voice in the system; appears sparingly to make accents feel like punctuation rather than decoration

soft-iris.$description: Soft Iris — Gradient tail for the brand violet — the lighter stop in hero headline gradients. Paired with #1d58c0 and #009639 only inside the carousel card color-blocks, not in chrome

studio-slate.$description: Studio Slate — Primary text, dark filled buttons, body borders, heading strokes. The working near-black that carries 90% of the interface's weight

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Hero and section background fill — the deep dark behind the gradient headline and 3D illustration. Slightly cooler/lighter than pure black to keep the violet legible

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Light-theme canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, hero overlay text

cloud.$description: Cloud — Soft alternate surface — sits beneath white cards for subtle banding between content sections

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline card and stroke surface, secondary card backgrounds in quiet zones

graphite.$description: Graphite — Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators.

iron.$description: Iron — Secondary text and secondary borders — one step stronger than Graphite for body sub-copy that still needs to recede

noir.$description: Noir — Highest-contrast text and the dominant border color across all surfaces. Used where maximum legibility or definition is needed

cobalt-pop.$description: Cobalt Pop — Carousel testimonial card accent background — appears as a solid color block beside the violet and green variants, not used in chrome

fern-pop.$description: Fern Pop — Carousel testimonial card accent background — third slot in the rotating brand color trio. Decorative only

lilac-wash.$description: Lilac Wash — Soft purple-tinted card surface used in the testimonial carousel — echoes the brand violet at 8% saturation

mint-wash.$description: Mint Wash — Soft green-tinted card surface in the testimonial carousel — companion to the Fern Pop color block

apricot-wash.$description: Apricot Wash — Soft warm card surface in the testimonial carousel — third pastel slot matching the apricot color block

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

inter.$description: The single typeface for the entire system. Regular (400) for body and micro-copy, Medium (500) for emphasized inline, SemiBold (600) for subheadings and UI labels at -0.031em tracking, Bold (700) reserved for the two display headlines (48px and 64px) at -0.021em / -0.016em. The negative letter-spacing on large sizes is what gives the wordmark its tight, poster-like feel; smaller sizes stay at normal tracking.

fira-code.$description: Inline code and token-name strings in the product mockup illustration. The only monospace voice; appears only inside the hero 3D scene, not in body copy.

inter-medium.$description: Inter-Medium — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

inter-semibold.$description: Inter-SemiBold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

inter-bold.$description: Inter-Bold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
